verdict.rationale: Skyvern's own docs say the agent downloads files from sites it operates, for example "downloading files and pulling data" and "Log into vendor portals, find invoices, download PDFs". That covers the download half of the story, but only as marketing-level mentions. Uploading files to sites is not evidenced; "SOP upload" is a workflow-authoring feature, not the agent uploading to a target site. The run artifacts docs cover recordings, screenshots, reasoning and network traffic, not retrieval of downloaded files. Missing for 10: documented file-upload capability, an explicit mechanism or API for retrieving downloaded files after a run, in-depth download docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
